target.title: feat(dashboard): redesign live and triage pages — editorial hero, stat ticker, worker rows, lobster theme
target.body:
Complete redesign of the ClawSweeper status dashboard and both triage pages: minimal, modern, and a tad lobstery. The layout is re-architected, not just reskinned — but behavior is unchanged: same data, same routes, same polling and drill-down logic.

## Before / after

![Dashboard before and after](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/raw/91edc024c93de80014e1d1412bead3cd825422c1/docs/assets/dashboard-redesign/dashboard-before-after.jpg)

![Triage before and after](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/raw/91edc024c93de80014e1d1412bead3cd825422c1/docs/assets/dashboard-redesign/triage-before-after.jpg)

<details>
<summary>More captures: dark variant, worker drill-down dialog</summary>

![Dashboard after, dark variant](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/raw/91edc024c93de80014e1d1412bead3cd825422c1/docs/assets/dashboard-redesign/dashboard-after-dark.png)

![Worker dialog after](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/raw/91edc024c93de80014e1d1412bead3cd825422c1/docs/assets/dashboard-redesign/dashboard-after-worker-dialog.png)

</details>

All "after" captures were rendered against a saved production `/api/status` / `/api/triage` snapshot served locally, so before and after show identical live data.

## Layout rework

- Editorial hero: a serif status headline with a health dot ("All clear — 27 claw workers sweeping 4 repositories") replaces the metric-card wall as the page's opening statement.
- The six metric cards became a borderless stat ticker — hairline-separated numbers, no boxes.
- The five-box flow map became a stepper: one continuous line with coral station dots and big counts.
- The 128-slot capacity dot matrix became a single stacked bar (coral running / amber waiting) with a plain-language meta line.
- The worker card grid collapsed into dense two-line rows in one panel — status dot, mode, name, live step, elapsed, and a micro progress bar per row; automatic builds share the same row treatment. Filters became a segmented control.
- Pipeline and sidebar lists went from individual boxes to hairline-divided rows inside single panels; sidebar stat tiles use the ticker treatment.

## Visual language

- Warm minimal theme following the system color scheme via CSS `light-dark()`: shell-white light mode, warm charcoal dark mode.
- One accent: lobster coral, marking everything alive — links, running capacity, in-progress steps, worker progress, heading ticks, the pulsing LIVE tag, and a 2px top stripe. Status colors stay semantic.
- All decoration removed (gradients, shimmer, glows, hover translates); tabular numerals; emoji gone from labels, lobster kept in title, header, and empty states.
- Triage: GitHub label colors render as neutral dot-pills instead of dark filled chips; issue titles are text-colored with coral on hover; same ticker metrics.

## Verification

- `pnpm run build:dashboard` (tsgo), `pnpm run lint:dashboard` (oxlint), `pnpm run format:check` all clean.
- `node --test test/dashboard-worker.test.ts`: 53/53 pass (UTF-8 emoji test updated for the new labels, mojibake guard kept).
- Visually verified every surface against the production snapshot in both light and dark: hero, ticker, stepper, capacity bar, automatic builds, worker rows and filters, both dialogs, pipeline, cluster intake, automerge, closed stats, worker health, operations, recent activity, and both triage pages.

Note: the stylesheet uses `light-dark()` and `color-mix()`, which need 2024+ evergreen browsers — fine for this maintainer-facing dashboard.
